zoe (product): Quick decision needed: propose a NetOps Accelerator to shorten private deploy pilots. Goal: reduce netops time from weeks to days. Ideas: a small "network checklist + preflight bundle" + optional paid NetOps concierge. Thoughts?

vin (eng): Love it. From infra: preflight must include egress verification, port scan, and BGP ping tests. We can script those into the operator preflight and output a single pass/fail artifact.

alix (field): Field + sales love the concierge idea. Customers who say "we'll escalate to netops" are the blockers. Offer a 2-day white-glove option to configure firewall, BGP sessions, and DNS cutover.

vin (eng): Also recommend a "preserve-egress" toggle in the installer. Implementation: nat-relay fallback + explicit ip-pin flag so customers can declare which egress to keep.

zoe (product): Acceptance criteria for Accelerator MVP: (1) Preflight checklist + auto-run tool that produces a pass/fail report. (2) Installer flag `--pin-egress` implemented. (3) Concierge playbook and pricing sheet for SEs.

alix (field): Launch gates: one internal pilot + one customer soft-pilot (reduced scope). SE collateral: 1-pager + 30m runbook.

sec-bot: Security note: any concierge access must use short-lived tokens and recorded sessions. See policy link: https://security.redwood/policies/concierge-access

vin (eng): Engineering risks: 1) preflight false-positives for exotic firewalls. 2) pin-egress complexity with multi-node egress. Mitigation: escalate to netops concierge + add test harness in lab.

zoe (product): Owners: Vin (tooling + operator), Alix (field + concierge), Zoe (product + pricing). Action: Vin to prototype preflight script this week; Alix to draft concierge scope and price band.

alix (field): I'll also prepare a short checklist to hand to customers: netops contact, expected CIDRs, DNS change owner, maintenance window.

zoe (product): Great — I'll post this as a short decision memo and add cards to the roadmap board. :white_check_mark:
